data.title: Secret Length Detectives!
data.description: Learn how to compare two objects by using a third reference object when they cannot be placed side-by-side.

challenges.instruction: Can you figure out which object is longer without placing them together? Read the clues to find out!
challenges.hint: Think about how each object compares to the paintbrush first.
challenges.narration: Welcome, detective! Let us use our special clues to solve this length mystery.
challenges.clue0: The fork is shorter than the paintbrush.
challenges.clue1: The paintbrush is shorter than the straw.

challenges.instruction: Use the clues about the feather to decide which object is longer!
challenges.hint: Compare the straw and the paintbrush to the feather to see which one stretches further.
challenges.narration: You are doing great! Let us try another puzzle with the feather.
challenges.clue0: The straw is shorter than the feather.
challenges.clue1: The feather is shorter than the paintbrush.

challenges.instruction: Read the clues carefully! Which item is the longer one?
challenges.hint: Check how both the fork and the feather relate to the straw.
challenges.narration: One more detective puzzle to test your super-smart math skills!
challenges.clue0: The fork is shorter than the straw.
challenges.clue1: The straw is shorter than the feather.
